paragraphs.text: 1. HE who sate down as Hotar-priest, the Rsi, our Father, offering up all things existing,-
paragraphs.original: य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत्पिता नः ।
paragraphs.translit: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdatpitā naḥ |

paragraphs.text: He, seeking through his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.
paragraphs.original: स आशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ आ विवेश
paragraphs.translit: sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarām̐ ā viveśa

paragraphs.text: 2. What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that supported him? How was it?
Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens.
paragraphs.original: यतो भूमिं जनयन्विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः
paragraphs.translit: yato bhūmiṃ janayanviśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides,
He, the Sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them, with his arms as wings, together.
paragraphs.original: सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन्देव एकः
paragraphs.translit: saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayandeva ekaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven?
paragraphs.original: किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ye thoughtful men inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.
5. Nine highest, lowest, sacrificial natures, and these thy mid-most here, O Visvakarman,
paragraphs.original: या ते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा ।
paragraphs.translit: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā |

paragraphs.text: Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessed, and come thyself, exalted, to our worship.
paragraphs.original: शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः
paragraphs.translit: śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Bring thou thyself, exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship.
paragraphs.original: विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām |

paragraphs.text: Let other men around us live in folly here let us have a rich and liberal patron.
paragraphs.original: मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु
paragraphs.translit: muhyantvanye abhito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu

paragraphs.text: 7. Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman.
paragraphs.original: वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम ।
paragraphs.translit: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema |

paragraphs.text: May he hear kindly all our invocations who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous.
paragraphs.original: स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा
paragraphs.translit: sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā
